name: Manwe
tagline: Local-first AI workspace and agent harness for Mac with persistent context
description: Manwe is a free AI workspace for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It organizes project context with Worlds and Moons and supports persistent agents, shared memory, skills and scheduled workflows. Users can choose local models or connect model providers. A local MCP helper makes selected context available to compatible assistants. Access to files, browsers and apps is controlled through permissions and approvals. Model provider fees are separate.
